 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 11-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Shahpur Patori P.S. Case No. 378 of 2022 for the offence registered under Sections 341, 323, 307, 272 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 12.09.2022 by the informant, Mina Devi.
As per the prosecution story, the lady was married to Abhinandan Rai but was tortured for dowry.
Further allegation is that he has married again and used to assault the informant so Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.47997 of 2023(2) dt.11-08-2023 that she leaves the place.
Further allegation is that he was duly supported by this petitioner and on the fateful day, he administered some substance which resulted into her falling ill and was taken to the hospital.

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that only to implicate them, the FIR has been exaggerated.

Further,
they are separated from the couple due to regular acrimony have nothing to do with it.
He further submits that the allegation does not match the treatment report of the informant dated 22.11.2022.
Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail they were also part and parcel of the assault on the informant.

Considering the fact that that the allegation is mainly against the husband, the petitioner nos. 1 and 2 are parents, aged couple and they do not have criminal antecedent, this Court is inclined to grant them privilege of bail.
